senses.gloss: f. (גבב) rakings, small stubble, straw &c., used as fuel.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:1">Sabb. III, 1</cite> sq., Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <cite ref="C00041"><he>גְּבָבָא</he></cite> Chald.). Y. ib. III, 5ᶜ bot., Bab. ib. 36ᵇ.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:1">Kel. XVII, 1</cite> <he>של בלנין בג׳</he> the vessels of the bathers cease to be susceptible of levitical uncleanness, when they are so defective as to let small fuel drop out.
